svg.title: Turks and Caicos Islands – Map
svg.desc: Natural-Earth-derived WGS84 land geometries in true relative positions: Providenciales, North Caicos, Middle Caicos, East Caicos, South Caicos, Grand Turk and Salt Cay. Major location markers. Underwater reefs, shoals and the Caicos Bank are not depicted as land.
svg.metadata: Target land: GSHHG/GSHHS full-resolution shoreline via Basemap 2.0.0 (Paul Wessel and Walter H. F. Smith; https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/wessel/gshhg/), assigned with Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0 map subunits ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19 (public domain) unit TCA (Turks and Caicos Islands); internal land boundaries follow Natural Earth. Surrounding land: the same GSHHG shoreline, drawn to the canvas edge. WGS84; local-equirectangular-fit-v1, 1200x760.
